groups.name: vespera.bridge.native
groups.description: Rust-side runtime knobs forwarded to the VesperaBridge configure* methods during context startup, before the first native dispatch. Unset values keep the native default (or the vespera.limits.* / vespera.dispatch.* / vespera.async.* / vespera.runtime.* system properties and their VESPERA_* environment variables).

properties.name: management.health.vespera.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the vespera native-library health indicator (UP when the library is loaded and running, OUT_OF_SERVICE after shutdown, DOWN otherwise). Requires Spring Boot Actuator.

values.description: Default since 0.2.0: DIRECT for small or bodyless safe requests, SYNC for small unsafe requests, bidirectional streaming for everything else.
Restores the pre-0.2.0 default: every request that may carry a body streams both ways; bodyless requests stream only the response.
Default: CORS preflights are routed to the Rust router, whose Access-Control-* headers win.
Spring MVC / Spring Security answer CORS preflights; Rust's duplicate Access-Control-* headers are dropped.
Default: the whole URL space (more specific Spring MVC handlers still win).
